data.description:
Looking for a premium and affordable men's PG in Powai, Mumbai? GharApna offers fully furnished PG accommodation designed for working professionals, students, interns, and bachelors who want a comfortable, secure, and hassle-free living experience. Located in the heart of Powai, our PG provides excellent connectivity to educational institutions, IT parks, corporate offices, and major transportation hubs across Mumbai.

GharApna's men's PG in Powai is strategically located just minutes away from IIT Bombay, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai Lake, and leading business parks. Whether you are a student at IIT Bombay, an employee working in Hiranandani Business Park, L&T Business Park, SEEPZ, MIDC Andheri, or nearby corporate offices, our property offers the perfect balance of convenience and comfort.

Our fully furnished rooms are thoughtfully designed to meet the needs of modern residents. Each room includes a separate bed with mattress, bedsheet, pillow and cover, personal wardrobe, curtains, side table, charging point for every bed, study table and chair, cloth hooks, drying space, and personal key access. The spacious and well-maintained setup ensures a productive and comfortable stay.

Residents enjoy a wide range of services included in the rent, including high-speed WiFi, gas connection, maintenance charges, water bills, daily and alternate-day cleaning, monthly deep cleaning, and monthly pest control. The property is equipped with modern amenities such as refrigerator, washing machine, geyser, gas with utensils, water purifier, housekeeping services, bike parking, and car parking facilities. Every facility is designed to provide a convenient and home-like living experience.

For food convenience, residents can prepare their own meals using the self-cooking facility. Additionally, multiple tiffin services, cafes, restaurants, and food delivery options are available nearby, making everyday living even easier.

One of the biggest advantages of staying at GharApna PG in Powai is its exceptional location. IIT Bombay Main Gate is just a short walk away, while Hiranandani Gardens, Powai Lake, Galleria Mall, D-Mart Powai, and Dr. L. H. Hiranandani Hospital are all within easy reach. The area is surrounded by some of Mumbai's most prominent IT parks, business hubs, and educational institutions.

Connectivity is another major highlight. Residents can easily access Kanjurmarg Railway Station, Asalpha Metro Station, Saki Naka Metro Station, and Marol Metro Station. Major roads including JVLR, Eastern Express Highway, LBS Marg, Saki Vihar Road, and Andheri-Kurla Road provide seamless travel to Andheri, Ghatkopar, Vikhroli, Saki Naka, and other parts of Mumbai.
